Pale skin, dark hair just visible under the hood, a clearly readable young face in profile with a visible eye, brow, nose and mouth. Realistic child body proportions, about 5.5 head-heights tall, matching the reference turnaround exactly in design, coloring and proportions. Rendered as a single cohesive hand-painted illustration with soft painterly brushwork and visible brush texture, in a muted earthy palette (grays, browns, warm skin tones), NOT a flat vector cutout, in the painted-storybook register of games like Hollow Knight or GRIS. A calm, relaxed idle standing pose, NOT walking or running, the same resting foot placement: both bare feet flat on the ground, weight settled evenly on both feet. She has just begun a slow breath in: her chest lifts very slightly, her shoulders rise by the smallest amount, and her arms still hang loosely at her sides with elbows barely more bent than at full rest. Full body visible from the top of the hood to the soles of both bare feet, and both hands, entirely inside the canvas with generous empty margin on every side so nothing is cropped. She stands at a consistent scale and vertical position: the same distance from the top of her hood to the ground line as in the reference image(s). Transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the character, no scarf or neck wrap of any kind -- bare gray robe collar at the neck; a separate layer will add the scarf later.
